name: Dinotamer Brann
guide_text: Typically, Murlocs and Elementals can utilize Brann the best, so you must have those tribes in.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up when it costs 3-5 gold, after you've unlocked Brann. No problem staying on tavern 2 one extra turn to do so.
